text: A ceramics teacher split his class in two. The planners lost.
One half would be graded on a single perfect pot. The other half, only on weight. Fifty pounds of pots got an A.
The perfect group spent the term planning, reading, theorising.
The other group just made pots. Ugly ones. Then slightly less ugly ones.
Guess which group made the best pots?
The quantity group. Every one of the best pots came from them. They learned from every lump of clay.
I was the planner. For years I wanted to make content, and I kept stopping.
So now I'm making pots. A video a day, from wherever I am.
Seneca said it two thousand years ago. While we are postponing, life speeds by.
Make your ugly pot today. And tell me: what are you still planning?
